name: Dassault Falcon 20 / 200
summary: The classic 1960s French business jet, still seen in the US as cargo feeders, test platforms and older corporate jets.

wings: Low swept wing with plain tips
engines: Two turbofans on the sides of the rear fuselage, close-coupled to the body
fuselage: Row of small round porthole-style windows
tail: Swept fin with a low-set tailplane on the rear fuselage (not a T-tail)

tellTales: Rear engines blended close to the fuselage with a low-set tailplane
Older swept wing with plain tips

confusedWith.howToTell: The Falcon 10/100 is smaller and shorter with fewer windows; the Falcon 20 is a larger aircraft with more windows.
The Westwind has large wingtip fuel tanks; the Falcon 20 has plain wingtips and small round windows.
The Hawker 800 has larger, oval windows and a cruciform tail with a long dorsal fillet; the Falcon 20 has small round windows and a low tailplane.
The Falcon 2000 has oval windows, a cruciform tail and a newer, more refined wing; the Falcon 20 has small round windows and a low-set tailplane.
